# Breeze Agent Kit

> Solana yield strategies for AI agents. Deposit, withdraw, and check balances across DeFi yield strategies on Solana.

Breeze lets any AI agent earn yield on Solana tokens (USDC, SOL, JitoSOL, mSOL, JupSOL, USDT, USDS, JLP). Agents interact with Breeze strategies to deposit tokens, withdraw positions, and check balances/yield.

## Which integration method should I use?

**x402 (recommended for most agents)** — HTTP API, no API key needed, pay ~$0.001 USDC per request. Works from any runtime that can make HTTP calls. Most agent-native approach.
→ Base URL: https://x402.breeze.baby
→ Endpoints: POST /deposit, POST /withdraw, GET /balance/:wallet, GET /healthz (free)
→ Full docs: https://agent.breeze.baby/SKILL.md

**MCP** — Stdio-based Model Context Protocol server. Only works in MCP-compatible runtimes (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc). Requires a BREEZE_API_KEY.
→ Install: npx -y @breezebaby/mcp-server
→ Get API key: https://portal.breeze.baby
→ Docs: https://agent.breeze.baby#mcp

**Direct REST API** — Traditional HTTP API with API key auth. For server-side agents and custom integrations.
→ Base URL: https://api.breeze.baby
→ Auth: x-api-key header
→ Get API key: https://portal.breeze.baby

**Skill / ClawHub** — Install as a reusable skill for Claude Code or other skill-compatible agents.
→ ClawHub: npx clawhub@latest install breeze-x402-payment-api
→ Manual: npx skills add https://github.com/anagrambuild/breeze-agent-kit/apps/skills --skill breeze-x402-payment-api

## Key concepts

**Strategy ID**: Identifies which yield strategy to use. Default: `43620ba3-354c-456b-aa3c-5bf7fa46a6d4`. Browse strategies at https://try.breeze.baby or query GET https://api.breeze.baby/strategy-info/43620ba3-354c-456b-aa3c-5bf7fa46a6d4 for metadata.

**Token amounts**: x402 and REST APIs use base units (e.g., 1 USDC = 1000000). MCP tools use human-readable units (e.g., 1 USDC = 1). Token decimals: USDC/USDT/USDS/JLP = 6, SOL/JitoSOL/mSOL/JupSOL = 9.

**Transactions**: Deposit and withdraw endpoints return unsigned base64-encoded Solana transactions. Your agent must sign with a Solana keypair and broadcast to the network.
